__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: 选择 common-tools 指标所在的 Prometheus 数据源

targets.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by (addr) (redis_pool_total_conns{app=~"$app", namespace=~"$namespace"})
  -
  sum by (addr) (redis_pool_idle_conns{app=~"$app", namespace=~"$namespace"}),
  0
)
